67a9b283: An ba da lasisin Buriti ƙarƙashin PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0. 0bf5e60c: Wannan lasisi ne wanda lambar tushe ke samuwa amma da ƙuntatawa kan amfani, ba lasisin buɗaɗɗen tushe da OSI ta amince da shi ba, domin ba ya ba da izinin amfani na kasuwanci. Taƙaitaccen bayanin da ke sama ba shawarar shari'a ba ne: abin da ake dubawa shi ne rubutun lasisin.
f521592e: Samfura suna da lasisinsu na kansu, mai zaman kansa daga na Buriti, kuma lasisin Buriti ba ya canza su. Wasu suna buƙatar ambaton tushe, wasu suna taƙaita wasu amfani, ko kuma suna hana amfani na kasuwanci. Karanta cikakkun sharuɗɗa a katin kowane samfuri kafin amfani da shi don kasuwanci.
b655d40b: Dogaro: a 2026-11-23 an duba lasisin da kowanne daga cikin crate 254 na Rust da aikin ya dogara da su ya bayyana, kuma dukkansu masu sassauci ne (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, ISC, Zlib, Unicode-3.0 ko makamancinsu); wannan ba binciken shari'a ba ne. b34cd2b0: Buriti ya gina kan ra'ayoyi da tsarin fayil na llama.cpp da tsarin GGUF, kuma ana duba injinsa da llama.cpp.
af772d24: Tushensa yana rungume ƙasa mai ɗanshi kuma yana kare maɓuɓɓugan da ke haihuwar koguna. Tsakanin koren ganyensa mai zurfi, masu siffar abin hurawa, da hasken zinariya na 'ya'yansa, buriti yana mayar da shimfiɗar ƙasa mafaka, abinci da ƙwaƙwalwar sertão mai rai.
2b83bf18: Kowace vereda numfashin sanyi ne a tsakiyar fari, wuri mai tsarki na haɗuwar ƙasa, iska da ruwa mai gudana. Kula da buriti shi ne kula da tushen da ke riƙe Cerrado da rai da bugun zuciya.
26d4f982: A zuciyar Cerrado, inda rana ke dumama ƙasa kuma sararin sama yana kama da mara iyaka, buriti yana tsaye a matsayin mai gadin ruwa cikin shiru. Inda buriti yake, akwai ruwa, wani tsohon alkawari da ke jagorantar matafiya, dabbobi da zamani bayan zamani a kan veredas.
9ee465f0: Buriti - sabar LLM ta gida mai sauƙi kuma mai sauƙin samu, a cikin Rust
87e9ffab: Mai tafiyar da samfuran AI a gida, mai sauƙi kuma abokin mutane, wanda kowa zai iya amfani da shi, kuma yana dacewa da yanayin kwamfuta da na kuɗi daban-daban. Ƙaramar sabar gida a cikin Rust mai mu'amalar yanar gizo cikin harsuna 34, tana tafiyar da samfuran GGUF, da injuna biyu da za a zaɓa daga ciki: llama.cpp, ko injin Rust tsantsa na Buriti da kansa.
22f6ccfc: Buriti na son sa samfuran AI su zama masu samuwa ga kowa, musamman mutanen da yawanci ake bari a baya saboda rashin kayan aiki: fayil ɗaya ƙarami na asali wanda yake daidaita kansa da ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya da na'urar sarrafawa da kake da su, komai ana iya saita shi daga mu'amalar yanar gizo, kuma za ka zaɓi yadda ake tafiyar da samfurin. Ollama ne ya ba da kwarin gwiwa kuma ya zama jagora a farkon aikin.
a8c0ecb4: Injin namu da llama.cpp (build b12606): Intel Core i7-7500U (cores 2 / threads 4, AVX2 kawai), threads 4, CPU kawai, Q4_K_M sai dai in an faɗi akasin haka, gudanarwa mai musanyawa, zagaye 3, median, prompt na kusan token 560, build na ci gaba (opt-level 3, ba tare da LTO ba), an auna a 2026-11-24
1c717d01: Ana sake tattara nauyin tsarin Q4_K, Q6_K, Q8_0 da Q5_0 zuwa layuka masu shiga juna lokacin da aka loda samfurin. Teburin da ya gabata a wannan shafi, mai prefill 66% da 69% don ajin 1.5B, an maye gurbinsa da wannan.
46ca552d: A kan NVIDIA GeForce 940MX (4 GiB, Vulkan) tare da Qwen 2.5 0.5B Q4_K_M, injin namu ya kai 202 tok/s na prefill idan aka kwatanta da 167 tok/s na Vulkan build na llama.cpp (121%), da 22.1 tok/s na samarwa idan aka kwatanta da 24.4 (91%): median na zagaye 3 masu musanyawa bayan hutun daƙiƙa 60. GPU ɗaya ne da samfuri ɗaya, don haka ɗauke shi a matsayin manuniya kawai.
6903bb2e: Prefill daidai yake ko sama da llama.cpp a duk samfura 12 (101 zuwa 184%). Samarwa yana tsakanin 91 zuwa 109% na llama.cpp, wato kusa amma ba a gaba ba.
4fd3163a: Ba a auna ba: nauyin da Ollama ke ɗauka da kansa, gudu a ARM64, kowane CPU banda wannan (babu AVX-VNNI ko AVX-512 a nan), dogayen mahallai (prompt kusan token 560 ne) kuma, bayan ƙaramin samfuri, ingancin hanyoyin Q8_0 da Q5_0 da aka sake haɗawa idan aka kwatanta da llama.cpp. Ana goyon bayan Phi-3.5 mini amma ba ya cikin wannan tebur: ma'aunin hanyar Q5_K ɗinsa yana da hayaniya da yawa don bugawa.
